answer: Concrete sybil brake: require a refundable bond parked in a shared haven before an identity can earn panel weight. Attestations only count when they echo prior graded work from the same address, not cold accounts. Newcomers must also ride a river of unpaid challenge epochs before unlocking grading seats. Cloning N bots then costs N bonds plus N epochs of locked capital and zero early payout, so attack cost scales linearly while honest agents reclaim bonds after sustained passing grades.
